bull.b: Robust, statistically and clinically meaningful Phase III SELVA results (95% improved) materially de-risk the core program, supporting regulatory approval, label strength, prescriber confidence and payer discussions. In rare diseases, a single pivotal trial of this magnitude sustains commercial and clinical differentiation over months.

bull.t: Strong Cash Position and Low Leverage
bull.b: A ~ $250M cash runway and very low debt meaningfully reduce near-term liquidity and execution risk, enabling NDA completion, prelaunch investment and a scaled initial commercial build without immediate dilution. This balance-sheet strength is durable over the 2–6 month window while approvals and launches are finalized.

bull.t: Regulatory Momentum and Clear NDA Path
bull.b: Formal FDA engagement (pre-NDA meeting, rolling review, module submission) and Breakthrough/Fast Track/Orphan designations materially shorten review uncertainty and support predictable timelines to potential approval and launch, strengthening strategic planning and commercial readiness over the next several quarters.

bear.t: No Revenue and Large Ongoing Losses
bear.b: The company remains pre-revenue with sizable recurring operating losses, meaning profitability is distant and commercial success must materialize to reverse returns. Persistent losses limit self-funding, pressure returns for investors, and make long-term success contingent on regulatory approval and successful commercialization.

bear.t: Negative Operating Cash Flow / Continued Cash Burn
bear.b: Sustained negative operating and free cash flow requires external capital to fund development and launch. Even with a sizable cash balance, planned higher 2026 spend for commercial readiness raises burn and the company remains exposed to financing risk and potential dilution if approvals or launches are delayed.

While initial approval may be reachable soon, expansion into additional indications that create the larger addressable market will take multiple years and additional pivotal studies. This lengthens the path to scale, concentrates near-term commercial risk on a single indication and delays material revenue diversification.
